calls.statement:
SELECT cs.format,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       COUNT(*) AS line_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_lines,
       COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS distinct_receipt_lines,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs  ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH mine AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, f.sale_date,
         COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
  GROUP BY 1,2),
ctl AS (
  SELECT store_id, business_date AS sale_date, receipts, net_sales_before_returns AS net
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND store_id<900)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS store_days, SUM(m.receipts) AS my_receipts, SUM(c.receipts) AS ctl_receipts,
       SUM(m.net) AS my_net, SUM(c.net) AS ctl_net,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.receipts<>c.receipts OR ABS(m.net-c.net)>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatched_store_days,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ctl) AS ctl_rows, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mine) AS mine_rows
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c USING (store_id, sale_date)

calls.statement:
SELECT 'receipts spanning >1 store/date/staff flag' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n FROM (
  SELECT receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
  GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT store_key)>1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT sale_date)>1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT staff_purchase_flag)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'zero/negative net lines', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND net_amount<=0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'fiscal period mismatch (dim_date P4 vs date range)', COUNT(*) FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=4 AND calendar_date NOT BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'store 999 lines', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_id=999 AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ZZ Test lines in physical stores', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category='ZZ Test' AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web-channel lines in physical store keys', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_id<900 AND (channel_code='WB' OR channel_id IN (SELECT channel_id FROM dim_channel WHERE channel_group='web')) AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'

calls.statement:
SELECT cs.format,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs  ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY cs.format
ORDER BY atv DESC
